svg.title: FVSD Nexus: three sources of truth
svg.desc: FVSD Nexus floats above three plinths: Dataverse, the record; the FVSDAnalytics semantic model, the calculation; and Entra ID, the identity. A dashed ring around them is Purview, the catalogue, which describes meaning, ownership and sensitivity but is not a fourth source of truth.

g.text: Where the work happens — never where the truth lives
Where it is created and managed
Who someone is, what they may use
Meaning, ownership and sensitivity — not a fourth source of truth
